preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 50000.
For each test case, k must be at least 2 and at most n, and n must not exceed 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each node value a_i must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: The number of edges must be n-1, and each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(xor_value == target_xor for xor_value in component_xors)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', all connected components must have the same XOR value.
